create_PbClient_simulation: create a PbClient physics simulation environment with GUI or DIRECT mode and set gravity
add_PbObject_to_scene: add a PbObject URDF model to the pybullet scene with a name, filename, and optional static flag
add_PbArticulatedObject_with_joints: add a PbArticulatedObject with controllable joints to the scene and read joint info from the URDF
capture_PbCamera_image_depth: capture RGB, depth, and segmentation images from a PbCamera positioned in the pybullet scene
get_PbArticulatedObject_joint_positions: get or set joint positions on a PbArticulatedObject and query link poses via forward kinematics
